title: The Scary Thing About AI And Creativity
description:
The scary part about AI isn’t that it makes creativity worthless.

AI just lowered the barrier to execution. It did not replace strategic thinking. So, what's really scary is people treating production and strategy like the same thing.

If you want help finding the way to get ahead of the AI curve for your brand, drop "STRATEGY" in the comments and we'll set up a call.
